build_cspnext_backbone_p5: build a CSPNeXt P5 backbone with default widen and deepen factors for RTMDet object detection
build_cspnext_backbone_p6: build a CSPNeXt P6 backbone with 5 stages for higher resolution feature extraction
create_cspnext_depthwise: create a CSPNeXt backbone using depthwise separable convolutions to reduce parameter count
freeze_cspnext_stages: freeze the first N stages of a CSPNeXt backbone for transfer learning fine-tuning
forward_cspnext_multi_scale: run a forward pass through CSPNeXt to extract multi-scale feature maps at specified output indices
